title: divider gives 0.83 V
report: The 3.3 V reference from the voltage divider measures about 0.83 V.

title: LED overcurrent
report: The status LED draws about 100 mA, five times its 20 mA rating, and runs hot.

title: LED never lights
report: The status LED never lights: no current flows through it, although the rail is at 5 V.

title: anti-aliasing filter cutoff too high
report: The 1 kHz anti-aliasing filter barely attenuates anything at 5 kHz; its cutoff is far too high.

title: amplifier has gain 1
report: The gain-of-11 sensor amplifier outputs 0.1 V for its 0.1 V input, i.e. a gain of 1.

title: button input stuck low
report: The push-button input reads low (0 V) even when the button is released.

title: high-pass filter acts as low-pass
report: The high-pass filter does the opposite of its job: it passes 100 Hz and blocks 10 kHz.

title: inverting amplifier output stuck at 0 V
report: The inverting amplifier's output stays at about 0 V whatever the input.
